sentences.text: The masthead light is a white light over the centerline, showing over an arc of two hundred twenty-five degrees, from right ahead to twenty-two and a half degrees abaft the beam on either side.
Sidelights are green on starboard and red on port, each showing over one hundred twelve and a half degrees, from right ahead to twenty-two and a half degrees abaft the beam on its own side.
On a vessel under twenty meters, the sidelights may be combined in one lantern on the centerline.
The sternlight is white, showing over one hundred thirty-five degrees aft.
The towing light is yellow, with the same arc as the sternlight.
An all-round light shows over three hundred sixty degrees.
A flashing light flashes a hundred twenty or more times per minute.
